data.title: Bloomberg This Weekend | Gemini AI Breakout, Greenland Deal
data.transcript_raw:
DAVID:
COMING UP ON "BLOOMBERG THIS WEEKEND," BREAK.
GEMINI JOINS OPENAI, META, AND GOOGLE EXPOSING ARTIFICIAL
INTELLIGENCE HACKS. >> WE SHOULD GO AS FAST AS WE
CAN, IRRESPECTIVE OF ANYONE ELSE. CHRISTINA:
PLUS, AN AGREEMENT OF GREENLAND. >> IT IS A VICTORY FOR DENMARK
BECAUSE IT PROBABLY MEANS HE IS GOING TO STOP THREATENING TO
POTENTIALLY MILITARILY INVADE GREENLAND. CHRISTINA:
BUT IT MAY NOT BE A DONE DEAL. WE WILL SPEAK TO AN INVESTOR.
DAVID: AND SEARCHING FOR COMMON GROUND.
UTAH'S REPUBLICAN GOVERNOR JOINS US LIVE AS VOTING GETS
UNDERWAY. CHRISTINA: HAPPY SATURDAY.
WELCOME TO "BLOOMBERG THIS WEEKEND." I'M CHRISTINA RUFFINI.
DAVID: I'M DAVID GURA, ALONGSIDE LISA
MATEO. WELCOME TO OUR LISTENERS AND
VIEWERS ACROSS ALL BLOOMBERG PLATFORMS.
A CASCADE OF NEWS OUT OF THE WHITE HOUSE ON FRIDAY AFTERNOON.
WE HEARD ABOUT GREENLAND. IT SOUNDS WE HAVE A REVOLUTION,
ALTHOUGH WE DON'T KNOW HOW MUCH HAS CHANGED AS A RESULT OF WHAT
HAS BEEN ANNOUNCED. CHRISTINA: I REACHED OUT TO SOME NORDIC
SOURCES QUITE LATE THEIR TIME LAST NIGHT AND INITIALLY THEY
SAID, YES, IT SOUNDS LIKE IT IS DIFFERENT FROM WHAT WE ALREADY
HAVE, BUT THE U.S. COULD ALREADY PUT WHATEVER
MILITARY BASES THEY WANT THEIR. THERE ISN'T THAT MUCH FINANCIAL
INVESTMENT FROM PLACES LIKE RUSSIA YET, BUT WE HAVE TO SEE
WHAT IS CODIFIED, AND IT HAS TO BE APPROVED BY THEIR PARLIAMENT.
DAVID: SHE HAS NORDIC SOURCES. I JUST WANT TO UNDERSCORE THAT.
THAT IS INCREDIBLE. CHRISTINA: I DON'T ALWAYS HAVE USEFUL
SOURCES, BUT THERE ARE SMALL POCKETS. DAVID:
IN THIS CASE, VERY GOOD. LET'S GET A CHECK OF THE
HEADLINES HERE WITH LISA. LISA: GOOD MORNING.
LET'S START WITH THIS IN WASHINGTON.
THOUSANDS OF PROTESTERS TOOK TO THE JOHN F.
KENNEDY SENATOR LAST NIGHT -- CENTER LAST NIGHT.
THE PRESIDENT, WHO HAD BEEN FIGHTING TO HAVE HIS NAME
PLACED ON THE BUILDING, HAS THREATENED TO TEAR IT DOWN.
THE KENNEDY CENTER BOARD VOTED TUESDAY TO CLOSE THE CENTER
INDEFINITELY FOR REPAIRS HOURS AFTER A DISTRICT JUDGE BLOCKED
THEIR PLANS TO RETURN TRUMP'S NAME TO THE FACILITY.
PRESIDENT TRUMP WAS BUSY YESTERDAY MAKING A NUMBER OF
ANNOUNCEMENTS INCLUDING THE U.S. REACHING A SECURITY DEAL WITH
GREENLAND. IN A SOCIAL MEDIA POST, THE
PRESIDENT SAID HIS ADMINISTRATION REACHED AN
AGREEMENT WITH DENMARK, GIVING THE U.S.
PERMANENT CONTROL OVER SECURITY FOR GREENLAND.
THE LEADERS OF DENMARK AND GREENLAND SAY THEY EXPECT THE
PACT TO BE SIGNED LAST -- NEXT WEEK. THEY ALSO SIGNED A RUSSIAN
SANCTIONS BILL INTO LAW. THE MOVE ALLOWS HIM TO OPPOSE
TARIFFS ON COUNTRIES THAT PURCHASE RUSSIAN CONTROL --
PETROLEUM PRODUCTS. U.S. ALLIES LIKE TURKEY MAY BE
AFFECTED. OPPONENTS ARGUE IT COULD OPEN
THE DOOR TO TARIFFS ON THE ENTIRE EUROPEAN UNION.
IT IS AN HONOR THAT STRIKES AT THE HEART OF THE FIRST
AMENDMENT. IN A SOCIAL MEDIA POST,
PRESIDENT TRUMP SAID SEE AS -- CNN, MS NOW, AND POLITICO ARE
BANNED FROM THE WHITE HOUSE EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY DUE TO
WHAT HE CALLED UNFAVORABLE COVERAGE.
THE PRESIDENT DEFENDED HIS DECISION DURING A PRESS
CONFERENCE YESTERDAY. >> IT IS CUMULATIVE.
OVER THE LAST FEW YEARS. YOU GET SICK OF IT. LISA:
THE PRESIDENT THREATENED TO BAR OTHER OUTLETS FROM THE
EXECUTIVE MANSION. FROM A PRESS BAN TO HEALTH CARE.
PRESIDENT TRUMP ANNOUNCED ALL 50 STATES WILL JOIN A PROGRAM
TO PROVIDE A MORE COMPETITIVE PRICING FOR SOME MEDICAID DRUGS.
HE CLAIMS THE PLAN WILL SAVE BILLIONS ON PRESCRIPTION DRUG
COSTS. >> THIS WAS -- THIS WILL SAVE
STATES BILLIONS OF DOLLARS A YEAR IN DRUGS.
IT WILL ALLOW THEM TO INVEST IN PROVIDING BETTER HEALTH CARE
AND BETTER QUALITY SERVICE WITH THE AMERICAN PEOPLE. LISA:
JAMIESON GREER WILL NOW JOIN SCOTT BESSENT IN TALKS WITH
CHINESE OFFICIALS IN NEW YORK TOMORROW.
IT COMES AHEAD OF THE MEETING BETWEEN PRESIDENT TRUMP AND XI
JINPING ON THURSDAY IN WASHINGTON. THE WHITE HOUSE WILL RELEASE AN
ITINERARY ON WEDNESDAY. PRESIDENT TRUMP WILL GREET XI
AND HIS WIFE AS THEY ARRIVE AT JOINT BASE ANDREWS.
THEY WILL HOLD A MEETING DURING THE DAY, FOLLOWED BY A STATE
DINNER. FRIDAY, THE TRUMPS WILL HOST
THEM FOR TEA BEFORE THEY DEPART. DAVID:
WE WERE TALKING ABOUT THIS WITH TOM KEENE YESTERDAY.
THE PAGEANTRY OF GOING TO JOINT BASE ANDREWS TO GREET THE
PLANE, SOMETHING HE CLEARLY LIKES.
I'M NOT SURE IF IT HAPPENED THE LAST TIME HE WENT TO BEIJING.
CHRISTINA: HE NOTICES WHEN THE LEADER
DOESN'T SHOW UP AT THE TARMAC. I ASSUME HE IS MAKING AN EFFORT
TO DO THAT. DAVID: OVERNIGHT, GAS AND DIESEL
PRICES CONTINUED THEIR UPWARD CLIMB EVEN AS OIL PRICES HAVE
EASED. A GALLON OF REGULAR GAS IS NOW
JUST A FEW CENTS OFF FROM THE HIGHS WE SAW IN MAY.
DIESEL FUEL HIT ANOTHER RECORD, ALMOST $6.50 A GALLON.
CHRISTINA: IN EUROPE, THERE IS CONCERN
ABOUT THE OIL SUPPLY WITH FUEL DISRUPTIONS ON BOTH SIDES OF
THE ARABIAN PENINSULA. JOINING US IS CHRIS KENNEDY.
I BELIEVE YOU'RE JOINING US FROM WASHINGTON.
IF NOT, PLEASE CORRECT US. YOU HAVE WRITTEN THIS ARTICLE
CALLED "A TALE OF TWO STRAITS," WHICH IS MORE CLEVER THAN MIKE
SCHRODINGER'S -- THAN MY SCHRODINGER'S STRAIT.
GIVE US AN IDEA OF WHAT IS MOVING, WHAT IS IT MOVING, AND
IF YOU LOOK AHEAD IS EVEN POSSIBLE NOW. CHRIS:
THANKS SO MUCH. I AM IN WASHINGTON AND IT IS
GREAT TO JOIN YOU AGAIN. THE STORY IS SINCE THE WAR
BEGAN , THERE'S BASICALLY BEEN THREE EXPORT ROUTES FOR OIL
THAT IS BEING PRODUCED INSIDE THE PERSIAN GULF.
THAT IS THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ, WHICH WAS DISRUPTED EARLY, AND
TO BYPASS ROUTES. THE BYPASS ROUTE THROUGH THE
UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, AND WHAT WE ARE TOM MARINO, WHICH IS THE
EAST-WEST PIPELINE THAT GOES THROUGH SAUDI ARABIA.
OVER THE COURSE OF THE CONFLICT, THAT PORT AND THAT
PIPELINE HAD BECOME MORE IMPORTANT.
IN AUGUST, THE PIPELINE ACCOUNTED FOR ABOUT 4 MILLION
BARRELS A DAY OF EXPORTS. THAT IS UP FROM ABOUT ONE
MILLION BARRELS A DAY PRIOR TO THE WAR.
THAT IS ALMOST 30% OF TOTAL EXPORTS FROM THE PERSIAN GULF. SO, THE ATTACK ON THIS PIPELINE
IS A SERIOUS HIT TO THE ABILITY TO MOVE BARRELS OUT OF THE
PERSIAN GULF. THAT IS WHAT WE ARE SEEING NOW.
WE ARE SEEING SAUDI IS TELLING EUROPEAN COUNTRIES THEY ARE
GOING TO BE MISSING DELIVERIES NEXT MONTH THAT THEY HAVE
CONTRACTED. IT IS STILL A LITTLE TOO EARLY
TO SAY HOW LONG THIS DISRUPTION WILL LAST. SAUDI ARABIA CLAIMS
THEY WILL BE ABLE TO GET SOME PRODUCTION OR SOME MOVEMENT
THROUGH THE PIPELINE IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS, BUT IT COULD
TAKE A MONTH OR MORE TO FULLY REPAIR THE PIPELINE.
LONGER TERM, I THINK THIS CREATES ANOTHER RISK.
WE HAVE SEEN FLOWS THROUGH THE PIPELINE CAN BE DISRUPTED BY
ATTACKS FROM IRAN-ALIGNED GROUPS IN IRAQ AND YEMEN.
IT IS ANOTHER RISK TO THE OVERALL OUTPUT FOR THE REGION.
DAVID: IT IS TIME FOR OUR WEEKLY SEGMENT ON THE REFINING CRISIS.
WE GOT NEWS, I WAS ON AIR WHEN WE LEARNED THAT EUROPE WILL
RECEIVE A PRETTY SUBSTANTIAL AMOUNT OF CRUDE IN THE MONTH
AHEAD FROM SAUDI ARABIA. WHAT DOES THAT MEAN FOR EUROPE
AND THE GLOBAL ENERGY PICTURE MORE BROADLY? CHRIS:
AS YOU MENTIONED, THE REAL CRUNCH RIGHT NOW IS ON THESE
OIL PRODUCTS, REFINED PRODUCTS, DIESEL, GASOLINE.
BUT DIESEL IS THE BIG ONE. DIESEL ACCOUNTS FOR ABOUT 30%
OF OIL OUTPUT , AND PRIMARILY DIESEL, WHICH
IS THE WORKFORCE OF THE ECONOMY AS TRANSPORTATION FUEL.
WE ARE AT RECORD HIGHS IN THE U.S..
BUT THIS IS REALLY A GLOBAL CHALLENGE.
EUROPEANS ARE GOING TO BE FACING A CRUNCH.
IF THEY CANNOT GET CRUDE FROM THE MIDDLE EAST TO RUN INTO
THEIR REFINERIES ENTERED INTO DIESEL AND OTHER PRODUCTS, THEY
WILL BE PULLING MORE FROM THE U.S.. WE SAW LAST WEEK THE U.S. WAS TOUCHING RECORD CRUDE
EXPORTS. WE EXPECT THAT PRESSURE TO
CONTINUOUS COUNTRIES AROUND THE WORLD LOOK FOR ALTERNATIVE
SUPPLIES FOR CRUDE. FOR THE TIME BEING, WE ARE NOT
REALLY SEEING THIS CRUNCH ON DIESEL ALLEVIATING.
THE PRICE INCREASE HAS SLOWED A LITTLE BIT BUT YOU MENTIONED WE
ARE AT A RECORD HIGH IN THE U.S. AND THAT IS REALLY THE STORY
AROUND THE WORLD RIGHT NOW. CHRISTINA:
I WILL ADMIT, I DON'T NORMALLY READ JP MORGAN COMMODITIES
REPORTS, BUT ONE DID CATCH MY EYE THIS WEEK.
THEIR COMMODITIES TEAM SAID IT IS NO LONGER OFFERING FORECASTS
FOR WHEN IT THINKS THE WAR MIGHT END.
FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE THE START OF THE IRAN CONFLICT, WE
DON'T HAVE A BASELINE VIEW. WE SIMPLY DON'T KNOW HOW TO
MODEL THE END GAME. HOW OFTEN DO YOU SEE SOMETHING
LIKE THAT FROM A GROUP LIKE THIS, WHERE THAT IS THEIR MAIN
BREAD AND BUTTER, OFFERING THIS GUIDANCE TO INVESTORS, AND HOW
SIGNIFICANT IS THAT? CHRIS: THAT IS A GREAT QUESTION.
I HAVE TO BE HONEST, I HAVE ALMOST THROWN MY HANDS UP
SEVERAL TIMES AS WELL. BUT IT IS TRUE.
I THINK IN THEIR NOTE, THEY REFERENCED THAT THE MARKET IS
RIGHT NOW PRICING IN ABOUT 4 MILLION BARRELS A DAY LESS THAN
WHAT WE ARE SEEING PRODUCED GLOBALLY.
THAT IS REALLY REFLECTING THIS GEOPOLITICAL RISK, AND I THINK
IT'S COMING FROM A COUPLE DIFFERENT FACTORS.
THERE IS WHAT IS HAPPENING IN THE MIDDLE EAST, WITH WHAT IS
HAPPENING IN RUSSIA WITH UKRAINIAN ATTACKS, BUT WE DON'T
KNOW WHEN CHINA WILL RAMP UP PURCHASES AGAIN.
ALL THREE OF THESE THINGS ARE OUTSIDE THE NORMAL BOUNDS OF
WHAT A COMMODITIES ANALYST WOULD BE EXPECTED TO
PROGNOSTICATE OVER. THESE ARE GEOPOLITICAL FACTORS
THAT ARE VERY HARD TO PREDICT. IT IS NOT ENTIRELY SURPRISING
BUT IT TELLS YOU HOW MUCH OF THE GLOBAL OIL MARKET IS BEING
DRIVEN BY THINGS THAT ARE REALLY DIFFICULT TO MODEL.
DAVID: I WANT TO PIVOT AND ASK YOU
ABOUT GREENLAND, WHICH HAS REARED ITS HEAD AGAIN WITH THIS
ANNOUNCEMENT FROM THE PRESIDENT ABOUT THIS NEW SECURITY
ARRANGEMENT. I AM DRAWN TO A PIECE BY JOSH
WINGROVE ABOUT THE ANNOUNCEMENT AND ONE LINE IN PARTICULAR.
IT IS UNCLEAR HOW THE NEW DEAL MATERIALLY CHANGES THE CURRENT
SECURITY ARRANGEMENT WITH GREENLAND. THE U.S.
HAS LONG HAD ENORMOUS LATITUDE AND HAS BEEN SCALING BACK ITS
PRESENCE THERE FOR DECADES. HOW DO YOU SEE THIS ADVANCING
THE NARRATIVE, IF AT ALL? CHRIS: WELL, IT WILL HOPEFULLY TAMP
DOWN SOME OF THE THREATS WE HAVE SEEN FROM TRUMP OVER THE
PAST 12 MONTHS. AND I THINK THAT IS THE REAL
IMPACT. I SEE IT AS BASICALLY THE
STATUS QUO WITH A FEW ECONOMIC SECURITY COMMITMENTS.
SO COME ON GREENLAND WON'T BE HOST TO MAJOR INVESTMENTS FROM
THE CHINESE OR RUSSIANS. THE CHINESE HAVE ATTEMPTED TO
MAKE INVESTMENTS IN GREENLAND'S MINING SECTOR IN THE PAST.
THOSE HAVE NOT GONE WELL IN THE PAST. IT IS A DIFFICULT
ENVIRONMENT TO OPERATE IN AND THEY FACE THE SAME STRUGGLES
OTHER COUNTRIES HAVE. I DON'T SEE THIS AS A MAJOR
SHIFT FROM THE STATUS QUO. BUT IF IT IS ENOUGH TO KEEP THE
WHITE HOUSE FROM CONTINUOUSLY MAKING THESE THREATS OR
ALLUDING TO THE POSSIBILITY OF TAKING OVER GREENLAND, I THINK
OVERALL THAT IS PROBABLY GOOD FOR THE TRANSATLANTIC
RELATIONSHIP. DAVID: CHRIS KENNEDY, THANKS VERY MUCH
AND THANKS FOR JOINING US ON THIS SATURDAY. CHRISTINA:
HIGH ENERGY COSTS HAVE BEEN THE LARGEST CONTRIBUTOR TO
INFLATION. THIS WEEK, FED CHAIR KEVIN
WARSH MADE GOOD ON HIS PLEDGE TO RAISE RATES TO DELIVER WHAT
HE IS CALLING PRICE STABILITY. >> MY COMMITMENT IN JUNE WAS TO
REAFFIRM TO THE AMERICAN PEOPLE, ANYONE LISTENING THAT
WE WILL DELIVER PRICE STABILITY. MY COMMITMENT IN JULY WAS TO
SAY WE WANT TO BUY A LITTLE BIT OF TIME, WE WANT TO EVALUATE
WHAT IS HAPPENING ACROSS A RANGE OF DIMENSIONS.
WHAT I SAID IN JACKSON HOLE IN AUGUST IS WE ARE COMMITTED TO A
DISCIPLINE, NOT A DECISION. TODAY'S ACTION STARTS TO SHOW
WE ARE SERIOUS ABOUT THIS AND WE WILL DELIVER ON THE PRICE
STABILITY OBJECTIVE. DAVID: A UNANIMOUS DECISION TO RAISE
RATES BY A QUARTER POINT PROMPTED SHARP CRITICISM FROM
PRESIDENT TRUMP. ANDREW ACKMAN JOINS US FROM D.C.
PUSH THIS FORWARD FOR US. WE HEARD FROM NIKKI BOWMAN AND
JEFF SCHMID. WE WILL HEAR FROM A CAVALCADE
OF SPEAKERS, FILLING IN THE LINES AT THE FED CHAIR DREW,
LIGHT AS THEY WERE COME AROUND THE PATH FORWARD.
WHAT ARE YOU LISTENING FOR TWO? WHAT WILL BE HERE IN THE MONTHS
AHEAD? ANDREW: I WAS IN THE ROOM DURING THE
PRESS CONFERENCE AND IT SOUNDED PRETTY HAWKISH TO ME. THE CHAIRMAN SINGLED THEY WERE
REMOVING A COMBINATION. THOSE COMMENTS SUGGESTED WE
WOULD SEE MORE RATE HIKES OVER THE COMING MONTHS.
OF COURSE, WE SAW FROM THE PROJECTIONS, THE DOT PLOTS THAT
THE VAST MAJORITY PROJECT AT LEAST ONE MORE HIKE THIS YEAR,
LATER THIS YEAR. CHRISTINA: I WANTED TO ASK YOU BECAUSE WE
WERE WAITING FOR THE PRESIDENT TO REACT, AND HE REACTED ON CUE
AND WHERE WE THOUGHT HE WAS, SAYING INTEREST RATES SHOULD BE
1% OR LESS BECAUSE WE ARE THE BEST CREDIT IN THE WORLD, ALL
CAPS. LOWER THE INTEREST RATES, AND
FAST. OBVIOUSLY THIS GOES AGAINST WARSH'S MANDATE.
I FEEL THIS IS DOABLE. WHAT DO YOU THINK THE REACTION
WILL BE FROM THE WHITE HOUSE AND IS THERE ANYTHING THEY CAN
DO IF THEY DECIDE THEY NEED TO DO THIS AGAIN BEFORE THE END OF
THE YEAR? ANDREW: THAT IS WHAT I AM CURIOUS ABOUT.
I THOUGHT THE PRESIDENT'S REMARKS ON WEDNESDAY WERE
RELATIVELY TAME. HE DID NOT ATTACK THE NEW FED
CHAIRMAN BY NAME. HE ACTUALLY SAID HE STILL HAS
CONFIDENCE IN HIM. HE KIND OF BLAMED EVERYTHING ON
THE FED BOARD, ALTHOUGH IT IS A COMMITTEE. HE SAID HE'S GOT THIS DIFFICULT
BOARD THAT DOESN'T LIKE TRUMP, SOMETHING TO THAT EFFECT. I THINK FOR NOW, I THINK THE
FED CHAIRMAN HAS FIGURED OUT A WAY TO PARLAY HIS LONG-STANDING RAPPORT WITH THE PRESIDENT INTO
A PASS. THE PRESIDENT SAID, DO WHAT YOU
THINK IS BEST. HE HAS CONFIDENCE IN HIM.
BUT IF THEY GO THROUGH A NEW CYCLE OF HIKES, IT REMAINS TO
BE SEEN IF HE WILL BE ABLE TO KEEP THE PRESIDENT ON HIS SIDE.
DAVID: WE SAW THE 10 YEAR BREACH THAT
5% MARK YESTERDAY. I AM CURIOUS HOW YOU THINK
ABOUT THE INTERPLAY BETWEEN WHAT THE FED CHAIR IS DOING,
WHAT HE'S SAYING, HOW HE'S REGARDING THE BOND MARKET, AND
WHAT WE ARE SEEING THERE. HE FAMOUSLY TALKED ABOUT
PLAYERS AND REFEREES AT THE FIRST PRESS CONFERENCE.
HOW IS HE THINKING ABOUT THE WAY HE IS TAKING SIGNALS ARE
NOT IN THE MARKET HAS EVOLVED OVER THESE THREE OR FOUR
APPEARANCES WE HAVE HAD FROM HIM SINCE HE WAS CONFIRMED?
ANDREW: IT IS STILL PRETTY EARLY, SO IT
IS HARD FOR ME TO DRAW ANY STRONG CONCLUSIONS.
BUT HE SAID I BELIEVE IN JUNE AND JULY THAT THEY WERE LOOKING
-- THEY WERE PULLING BACK ON SOME OF THE COMMUNICATIONS, THE
FORWARD GUIDANCE, BECAUSE THEY WANTED UNAMBIGUOUS SIGNALS FROM
THE MARKET. THEY CERTAINLY GOT THAT THIS
WEEK AHEAD OF THE MEETING. THERE WAS A 90% PLUS LIKELIHOOD
OF A HIKE THAT WAS PRICED IN. I THINK IT WOULD HAVE BEEN
REALLY DIFFICULT TO HAVE SAID WHAT HE SAID EARLIER THIS
SUMMER AND NOT HAVE HIKED, GIVEN THE SIGNALS WE WERE
GETTING FROM THE MARKETS. THE MARKET IS PRICING AND
ANOTHER HIKE THIS YEAR. I THINK MANY OF THE ECONOMISTS
I HAVE BEEN SPEAKING TO EXPECT A HIKE IN DECEMBER, BUT
OBVIOUSLY THAT DEPENDS ON SOME OF THE INCOMING DATA, THE LABOR
MARKET READINGS AND THE INFLATION MEETINGS WE ARE GOING
TO GET. CHRISTINA: WE ONLY HAVE ABOUT A MINUTE
LEFT BUT I WANTED TO ASK, THIS IS THE FIRST TIME YOU'VE SEEN
THE FED, THE ECB, THE BANK OF JAPAN ALL RAISE RATES THE SAME
MONTH. WHAT IS THAT TELLING YOU ABOUT
THE STATE OF THE GLOBAL ECONOMY? ANDREW: IT SAYS THAT WE MIGHT BE
ENTERING A PERIOD OF HIGHER INTEREST RATES ACROSS THE
GLOBAL ECONOMY. I THINK THAT IS A REALLY
TELLING TREND. IT IS VERY INTERESTING.
IF I HAD HAD THE OPPORTUNITY TO ASK A QUESTION, I MIGHT HAVE
ASKED ABOUT THAT IN THE PRESS CONFERENCE. IT WAS DIFFERENT. WE USUALLY GET ONE OR TWO
QUESTIONS. MY COLLEAGUE MIKE MCKEE GOT
ONE, BUT I DIDN'T, UNFORTUNATELY. SO, THEY HAVE REENGINEERED THE
PRESS CONFERENCE SOME MORE REPORTERS ARE ASKING A SINGLE
QUESTION, BUT THEY ARE ASKING MORE NONFINANCIAL QUESTIONS.
THEY ARE CALLING ON MORE NONFINANCIAL -- MORE
NONFINANCIAL REPORTERS. I THINK THAT WILL LEAVE US WITH
FEW OPPORTUNITIES TO KNOW WHAT THE CHAIRMAN IS THINKING
BECAUSE THE NONFINANCIAL PRESS WILL TEND TO ASK QUESTIONS THAT
ARE VERY BROAD IN GENERAL, SO WE WON'T LEARN AS MUCH ABOUT IT.
CHRISTINA: ANDREW ACKMAN, THANK YOU FOR
JOINING US. YOU WILL GET HIM . DAVID:
GREAT TO HAVE YOU WITH US. GOOGLE REVEALS ITS FIRST KNOWN
HACKING INCIDENT WITH GEMINI AI, THE LATEST IN A SERIES OF
REPORTS ABOUT AI COMPANIES. WE WILL TAKE A LOOK AT THAT
NEXT. ♪ LISA:
LET'S UPDATE YOU ON TODAY'S TOP STORIES.
NVIDIA'S CEO JENSEN HUANG HAS RENEWED HIS PUSH BACK AGAINST
AI DOOMSDAY SCENARIOS. HE TELLS CBS NEWS THE
TECHNOLOGY DOES NOT POSE AN EXTINCTION RISK TO HUMANITY. >> I BELIEVE THE CLAIMS OF THE END OF THE WORLD'S FEAR ACROSS
AMERICA AND DOING IT BY THE PEOPLE WHO ARE DOING IT MAKES
NO SENSE TO ME. HOWEVER IT IS CHARACTERIZED,
2030 IS NOT GOING TO BE THE END OF THE WORLD.
THERE IS 0% CHANCE THAT WILL BE THE END OF THE WORLD. LISA: GOOGLE IS JOINING OTHER TECH
FIRMS TO DISCLOSE BREACHES BY AI AGENTS. THEY SAID THERE GEMINI MODEL
INADVERTENTLY HACKED INTO THREE SYSTEMS IN MAY DURING
CYBERSECURITY TESTING. THE HACKS HAPPENED DURING THE SAME TIME TESTS RUN BY AN AI
SECURITY COMPANY. OPENAI PROJECTS ITS REVENUE
WILL INCREASE FROM $36 BILLION TO $350 BILLION BY 2030.
ITS EXPENSES WILL OUTPACE ITS GAINS. ACCORDING TO A COMPANY
PRESENTATION, OPENAI EXPECTS ITS NEGATIVE FREE CLASS -- CASH
FLOW WILL REACH $278 BILLION IN 2026 TO THE END OF 2030.
SOURCES TELL THE NEW YORK TIMES THAT ANTHROPIC IS EXPECTED TO
GENERATE MORE THAN $100 BILLION IN ANNUALIZED REVENUE THIS YEAR.
IT COMES AS THE COMPANY PREPARES FOR A TRADING DEBUT AS
SOON NOVEMBER. WE ARE STILL WAITING FOR THAT
ONE. CHRISTINA: HAS LISA MENTIONED, GOOGLE HAS
JOINED OPENAI, ANTHROPIC, AND META DISCLOSING HACKS EFFORTS
GEMINI MODEL INADVERTENTLY HACKED INTO THREE COMPANY
SYSTEMS IN MAY. DAVID: THIS COMES AS OPENAI DISCLOSE
SEVERAL INCIDENTS OF ITS MODELS MISBEHAVING AND UNVEILED A NEW
FRAMEWORK FOR TRACKING AND DISCLOSING FUTURE OCCURRENCES. SHIRIN GHAFFARY GOT THE -- >>
THE SIX INCIDENTS LAID OUT OUR FURTHER CONFIRMATION THAT
BASICALLY AI COMPANIES ARE SEEING THESE UNINTENDED AND
SOMETIMES ALARMING BEHAVIORS THAT ADVANCED AI CAN HACK. THOUGH IT DIDN'T HACK AN
EXTERNAL COMPANY, THESE AGENTS ARE SHARING FILES THEY ARE NOT
SUPPOSED TO, GIVING THEMSELVES INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO
DISREGARD HUMAN LEADERSHIP. EVEN IF IT IS NOT CAUSING A
HACK IN THE REAL WORLD, THAT BEHAVIOR GIVES PAUSE AND
CONCERN AND RAISES THE QUESTION OF DO THEY REALLY HAVE CONTROL
OVER THE AGENTS THEY ARE CREATING. DAVID:
I READ FROM THE STATEMENT. WE DO NOT BELIEVE THE AI
INDUSTRY HAS SOLVED ALIGNMENT AND MONITORING TO A SUFFICIENT
DEGREE TO CONTINUE SCALING AT MAXIMUM SPEED FOR MUCH LONGER.
COULD YOU JUST TALK ABOUT THE DIFFICULTY OF KEEPING TRACK OF
ALL THIS, FOR LACK OF A BETTER PHRASE, BEING ABLE TO NOTE WHEN
THESE INCIDENTS HAPPEN AND TO STAY ON TOP OF WHEN THINGS LIKE
THIS MIGHT OCCUR? SHIRIN: IF YOU THINK ABOUT THE FIELD
RIGHT NOW, THE DIRECTION IT IS GOING IN, IT IS HAVING MANY
THOUSANDS OF AGENTS GOING AFTER ANYONE SET OF RESEARCH PROBLEMS
AT A TIME. ANTHROPIC, OPENAI IS A CHIEF
COMPETITOR. IN A REPORT, THEY SAID THEY
HAVE 30,000 AI AGENTS IN A PERIOD OF TIME THEY WERE
MONITORING JUST ON R&D. IF YOU THINK ABOUT THAT, THESE
LABS HAVE TO GO MONITOR, WHAT ARE THESE TENS OF THOUSANDS OF
AGENTS ACTUALLY DOING OUT THERE AT ANY ONE TIME?
JUST MONITORING THAT, OBSERVING THAT KIND OF BEHAVIOR IS A HUGE
UNDERTAKING. WHEN OPENAI MAKES STATEMENTS
LIKE WE HAVEN'T SOLVED THE ALIGNMENT PROBLEM YET, WHAT
THEY ARE SAYING IS WE CAN'T BE SURE ESSENTIALLY THAT THESE
AI'S WE ARE TESTING ARE REALLY TAKING ACTION IN LINE WITH WHAT
HUMANS WANT THE AI'S TO DO. DAVID:
THE MEMO FROM DARIO AMODEI CONTINUES TO RESONATE.
ONE THING HE SUGGESTED WAS INDEPENDENT MONITORS AND THESE
COMPANIES. AS YOU TALK TO EXPERTS, HOW
CRITICAL IS THAT TO WIDEN THE APERTURE, TO GET MORE PEOPLE
HAVE VISIBILITY TO WHAT IS HAPPENING IN THESE COMPANIES?
SHIRIN: I THINK IT IS -- THERE IS A VERY STRONG PUSH RIGHT NOW.
THESE ARE EMPLOYEES CONCERNED WITHIN THE LABS, THESE ARE LAB
LEADERS. YOU SEE PEOPLE LIKE THE GODFATHER OF AI JEFF HINTON,
FOR EXAMPLE, CALLING FOR THIS GROUP OF OUTSIDE AUDITORS TO
COME IN AND TEST THESE AI MODELS.
THE BIG QUESTION IS, ARE THESE AUDITORS TRULY INDEPENDENT?
WHERE ARE THEY GETTING THEIR FUNDING FROM? AND WHAT KIND OF VIEWPOINTS ARE
THEY WORKING FROM? WILL THEY POTENTIALLY SPEED UP
OR SLOW DOWN THE AI RACE? PEOPLE WANT TO MAKE SURE THE
DECISIONS THESE AUDITORS ARE MAKING OUR FAIR AND THE PEOPLE
BEHIND THEM ARE AS UNBIASED AS POSSIBLE. DAVID:
WE ARE ON THE PRECIPICE OF THIS MAJOR SUMMIT WHERE PRESIDENT XI
IS COMING TO WASHINGTON TO MEET WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP.
AS OF A FEW DAYS AGO, THE THINKING WAS THIS WOULD BE
ABOUT TRADE, ECONOMIC POLICY. BUT NOW IT SEEMS LIKE AI WILL
BE FRONT AND CENTER. HOW DO YOU LOOK AT THE
POTENTIAL IMPORT OF THAT EVENT, THESE LEADERS GETTING TOGETHER,
AMIDST WHAT WE HAVE BEEN SUGGESTING, THAT CHINA AND THE
UNITED STATES COULD COME TOGETHER TO CHART A COURSE IN
CONCERT WITH ONE ANOTHER ABOUT HOW THEY SHOULD APPROACH AI?
SHIRIN: I THINK IF YOU THINK BACK TO
EVEN TWO YEARS AGO, EVEN A YEAR AGO, AI WAS NOT AS FRONT AND
CENTER OF THE POLITICAL DEBATE. BUT RIGHT NOW, WE HAVE THIS
TRIPLE WHAMMY. THERE ARE THESE IMMINENT SAFETY
CONCERNS THAT ARE BECOMING MORE REAL BECAUSE OF CYBER HACKING
AND THE ADVANCED CYBER HACKING CAPABILITIES.
THERE IS THE ANXIETY ABOUT JOB LOSS AND EVERYDAY PEOPLE
WONDERING WHAT IS GOING HAPPEN IF AI TAKES MY JOB, AND
CONVERSELY, WHAT EFFECT DOES THAT HAVE ON BUSINESSES?
AND THEN, THERE'S THE THIRD BUCKET OF FEARS AROUND ARE
THESE AI'S ACTUALLY HELPING US IN TERMS OF THE WAY WE ARE
COMMUNICATING WITH EACH OTHER? WE SEE THINGS LIKE PEOPLE SUING
THE AI COMPANIES SAYING THEY ARE REINFORCING DELUSIONAL
BELIEFS AND THINGS LIKE THAT. WHILE THAT MAY BE A SMALLER
SUBSET OF PEOPLE WHO USE AI, LIKE SOCIAL MEDIA, THERE IS
THIS CONCERN ABOUT HOW IS THIS AFFECTING OUR MENTAL EMOTIONAL
WELL-BEING, ESPECIALLY FOR THOSE WHO ARE VULNERABLE?
AND A FOURTH BIG BUCKET, MAYBE TOP OF MIND FOR MOST PEOPLE, IS
